body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: df85ed7efbb8ad7cd8cb77923624bce3ad1b5474 -->
Needs changes before merge.

Requested before merge:

1. `assets/posts/richauto.cps:209`: Include the operation name in each coolant refusal. The current warning omits it. `startSectionBody()` clears `opName` at line 260 before it calls `coolantCode()`. I reproduced this through the CLI with operation `ReviewCoolantOp` and a Flood entry that states `M7`. The only warning was:
   ```text
   warning: RichAuto DSP A11 flood coolant requires M8, got M7
   ```
   The warning must identify the operation, as required by `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`, “The machine is truth.” Add a regression test with a unique operation name. The existing name `A11` also occurs in the controller name.
2. `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs:55`: Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Record its lanes and results in the PR body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review,” requires this before readiness. The body states `Heavy lanes: not run`. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects every app heavy target because this registry file changes: 205 planned steps. A dry run is not a test pass.

The post tests cover clearance, unsupported operations, drilling, arc planes, origin translation and the block format. No existing golden changed. I read all 24 new goldens line by line.

Local verification used the trial merge with upstream/main `62353ac753947eba162538e0d9305ad86858cfb3`. No GitHub runner was used.

- Quick gate: **762 of 764 steps passed**. Both build steps passed. Two app suites failed, as listed below.
- Clippy: passed for `camcraft-post` and `camcraft-app`, with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Heavy and light lanes: not run.

Extra suites run:

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post --test script_richauto` | 41 passed |
| `camcraft-post --test recorded_streams` | 12 passed |
| `camcraft-post --test comment_escape` | 4 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test conformance` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |

I repeated two recorded mutations with CLI assertions. All mutation scripts and evidence stayed under `/tmp`. Repository source was unchanged.

- Remove the final `%`: RED on the final-line assertion; the original script then passed and matched the committed arc golden.
- Add spaces between words: RED on the compact-block assertion; the original script then passed and matched the same golden.

The two gate failures also failed on unchanged upstream/main `62353ac75` in a control run. They occur before RichAuto posting. They are base failures, not changes introduced by this PR. Readiness still requires a green gate.

- `crates/app/tests/blind_slot.rs:142`, `blind_slot_pocket_family_cuts_from_end_wall_to_stock_edge`: 3 passed, 1 failed.
  ```text
  assertion `left == right` failed: Adaptive2D
    left: 1
   right: 0
  ```
- `crates/app/tests/corner_relief_safety.rs:177`, `adaptive2d_spiral_and_offset2d_support_relief_while_trochoidal_and_do_not_touch_refuse`: 2 passed, 1 failed.
  ```text
  adaptive2d dogbone verify must be silent: [StrategyFallback { at: 2, areas: 1 }]
  ```

Both failures repeated on the trial merge and on the base. The other five extra suites passed.

Nonblocking notes: `posting_files.rs` grows from 418 to 421 lines. `conformance.rs` grows from 512 to 520 lines. Both already exceeded 400 lines. No controller test ran; the body records the unconfirmed A11 behavior.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
